Day 24 (old art) - March 2016 (age 13)

heyyy a digitalized sketch! honestly one of my favorite workflows

something about sketching traditionally hits different and being able to draw over it and render and experiment without destroying the sketch :>

(also a tiny Marionette at the top, I don't think we even knew her name back then. 10 years is a long time 😭)
